title: Mirror Stretch
statement:
A linked list is stored in `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means no next node). The list starts at node `head` and passes through all `n` nodes exactly once.

Find the longest block of consecutive nodes whose values read the same forwards and backwards. Print its length.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `head`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print the length of the longest such block.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 20000` (the whole input is at most about 200 KB)
- `0 <= v_i <= 10^6`
